title: Projects
text: Here you can have a look on some of my Projects, please klick on the button to test them out!

loco.title: El Pollo Loco
loco.text: Jump and Run with throw Functions based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to get Coins and fight aginst the Crazy Chicken.

bubble.title: VideoFlix
bubble.text: Videoflix is a video streaming app inspired by Netflix. It enables users to stream videos with real-time transcoding to ensure the best possible quality based on the current internet connection.

join.title: Join
join.text: Task Manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories
